description: Fast Rust-based Windows file manager with tabs, previews, full-computer search, and optional Explorer integration.
notes: innosetup: true makes Scoop extract only the Inno Setup {app} payload; the vendor setup routine is not executed. The extracted app does not install the Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 x64 Redistributable, enable Media Feature Pack on Windows N, or install the optional 7-Zip task; install the required dependencies separately (7-Zip is needed only for RAR/7Z/ISO previews). The vendor-created Start Menu and optional desktop shortcuts are not created; Scoop creates the Start Menu shortcut declared in this manifest. Prime Files' built-in updater checks for the Inno uninstaller (unins000.exe), which extraction does not create, so use Scoop to update Prime Files. The PrimeFilesIndexer service remains opt-in inside the app and is not installed by Scoop.
